breakpoints.note: The witness passes the SPIX magic check and the size/dimension sanity checks in pixDeserializeFromMemory, so Leptonica admits the input as an image and returns a PIX to the barcode path.
First project-side read of attacker-controlled image geometry from the SPIX buffer. These statements materialize the witness as a 75x32, 1 bpp image whose pixels later enter barcode processing.

The clamp predicate is reversed. When the requested scan count exceeds the crop height, the code should reset `nscans` to `h`, but this condition instead takes the out-of-range path and leaves `nscans` larger than the image.

The raster-averaging loop reads a byte through `line = data + i * wpl` after the scan window is derived so that `last > h - 1` and at least one loop iteration indexes beyond the valid row range. AddressSanitizer reports that this 1-byte read lands in the heap region of a temporary PIX that was already freed at pixLocateBarcodes:412.
